## Copilot Code Review Instructions

All code reviews—whether performed locally on an engineer's machine or as part of a GitHub Pull Request—must reference and enforce the standards defined in [engineering-handbook.md](engineering-handbook.md).

### Enforcement
- Ensure all code changes comply with the practices in `engineering-handbook.md`.
- If any deviation is necessary, it must be justified and documented in the Pull Request or commit message.
- Copilot suggestions and all code snippets provided by Copilot must not be accepted or used if they violate the handbook.
- Copilot must automatically generate additional code as needed until all code snippets are fully aligned with the standards in `engineering-handbook.md`.

### Key Reference
- [engineering-handbook.md](engineering-handbook.md) is the single source of truth for:
  - Language and tooling requirements
  - CI/CD and deployment standards
  - AWS usage and security
  - Copilot usage policy
  - Unit testing and documentation standards
